summary: Gone lookout on Magruder Mountain, Idaho County: 1933 camp, 1940 log cabin, destroyed 1950; one 1936 summer lookout found; site today not described.

facts.design: log cabin atop the north point (by 1940)
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1950 according to all three sources; no source describes what remains.

events.note: Camp at the site; the sources do not say what it was for
Ralph Wanderer Jr. spent the summer as a lookout, per a 1936 Ravalli Republic item quoted by the Forest Lookouts page
Log cabin atop the north point
No cause given in the sources

evidence.supports: 1940 log cabin atop the north point
does not yet have a documented staffing history
evidence.quote: We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

evidence.supports: 1933 camp, 1940 log cabin atop north point, destroyed 1950
evidence.quote: 1933: camp. 1940: log cabin atop north point. Destroyed 1950.

evidence.supports: five miles west of the Magruder Ranger Station
1936 summer lookout, quoting the Ravalli Republic
evidence.quote: Ralph Wanderer Jr. returned to Hamilton Saturday after spending the summer as a lookout on Magruder mountain in the Deep creek region.

corrections.why: Idaho is the state; firelookout.com gives the county as Idaho County, Idaho

notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on the 1933 camp, 1940 cabin and 1950 destruction. The 1936 staffer rests on one secondary quote (Forest Lookouts quoting the Ravalli Republic); we could not find the original item in web search. The Forest Lookouts page cites Kresek, which we did not read. Elevation 7,428 ft appears in two sources; the record has no elevation field filled. The access level stays unknown: no source gives one, so no access fact is recorded.
